# Hordaland County, Norway Genealogy



[Norway](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Norway_Genealogy "Norway Genealogy")

Hordaland County

Guide to **Hordaland ancestry, family history and genealogy:** birth records, marriage records, death records, census records, parish registers, and military records.

|  |
| --- |
| [Locator map of Hordaland county](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/index.php?title=File:Hordaland-Norway.png&filetimestamp=20170412221808&) Hordaland county |

## History

Hordaland is a county in Norway, bordering [Sogn og Fjordane](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Sogn_og_Fjordane_County,_Norway "Sogn og Fjordane County, Norway"), [Buskerud](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Buskerud_County,_Norway "Buskerud County, Norway"), [Telemark](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Telemark_County,_Norway "Telemark County, Norway") and [Rogaland](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Rogaland_County,_Norway "Rogaland County, Norway"). Hordaland is the third largest county after [Akershus](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Akershus_County,_Norway "Akershus County, Norway") and [Oslo](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Oslo_County,_Norway "Oslo County, Norway") by population. The county administration is in [Bergen](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Bergen_City,_Norway_Genealogy "Bergen City, Norway Genealogy"). Before 1972 Bergen was a separate entity (Bergen county) from Hordaland.
